title: A fragment or a skeleton?
hook: Different fossils expose different amounts of anatomy.

knows: Fossils and models can supply evidence about the past.
doesNotKnow: The second schematic shows a skull, backbone, limbs and tail, while the first shows only a tooth. A fragment can still carry useful evidence, but this example exposes fewer structures for comparison.

misconception: A single fragment exposes as much whole-body anatomy as a more complete skeleton.
objective: In this comparison, which fossil gives more body features to compare with another animal?

claims.text: Different fossils expose different amounts of anatomy. In this comparison, which fossil gives more body features to compare with another animal? claims.text: Recall: A fossil preserves only a tooth. What limitation should you keep in mind when comparing whole-body anatomy? One preserved part does not expose the rest of the skeleton.

recall.question: A fossil preserves only a tooth. What limitation should you keep in mind when comparing whole-body anatomy?
options: The tooth proves exact body color
Most body structures are not present in that fragment
The full skeleton is automatically visible
recall.why: One preserved part does not expose the rest of the skeleton.
